drivingQuestion: What was Moses' response to God's offer 'I will make of you a great nation'?
outcomeNote: Aggadic exposition of Moses' reply; no difficulty or dispute is raised.

segments.he: ״וְאֶעֱשֶׂה אוֹתְךָ לְגוֹי גָדוֹל וְגוֹ׳״. אָמַר רַבִּי אֶלְעָזָר: אָמַר מֹשֶׁה לִפְנֵי הַקָּדוֹשׁ בָּרוּךְ הוּא: רִבּוֹנוֹ שֶׁל עוֹלָם, וּמָה כִּסֵּא שֶׁל שָׁלֹשׁ רַגְלַיִם אֵינוֹ יָכוֹל לַעֲמוֹד לְפָנֶיךָ בִּשְׁעַת כַּעְסֶךְ. כִּסֵּא שֶׁל רֶגֶל אֶחָד — עַל אַחַת כַּמָּה וְכַמָּה!
segments.en: In the same verse, God promised Moses: «“And I will make of you a great nation.”» What was Moses’ response? «Rabbi Elazar said: Moses said before the Holy One, Blessed be He: Master of the Universe, if a chair with three legs,» the collective merit of the three forefathers, «is unable to stand before You in Your moment of wrath, all the more so» that «a chair with one leg,» my merit alone, will be unable to withstand your wrath.

segments.he: וְלֹא עוֹד אֶלָּא שֶׁיֵּשׁ בִּי בּוֹשֶׁת פָּנִים מֵאֲבוֹתַי, עַכְשָׁיו יֹאמְרוּ: רְאוּ פַּרְנָס שֶׁהֶעֱמִיד עֲלֵיהֶם. בִּקֵּשׁ גְּדוּלָּה לְעַצְמוֹ, וְלֹא בִּקֵּשׁ עֲלֵיהֶם רַחֲמִים.
segments.en: «Moreover, but I have» a sense of «shame before my forefathers. Now» they will «say: See» this «leader that» God «placed over» Israel. «He requested greatness for himself but did not pray for» God to have «mercy upon them» in their troubled time.

moves.summary: R' Elazar expounds Moses' reply: a chair of one leg cannot stand where a chair of three legs could not
moves.about: Moses' reply to the offer: if the merit of three forefathers could not stand, his alone surely cannot

moves.summary: A second reason in Moses' reply: he would be shamed before the forefathers as a leader who sought greatness for himself
moves.about: Moses pleads that his sole merit cannot withstand God's wrath and that accepting would shame him before the forefathers
